question: Novelist Damodar Mauzo, who has won the 57th Jnanpith Award, is a writer in which of the following languages?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Konkani**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Damodar Mauzo**

 
 
• He is a **Goa-based poet**.
 
• He won the Sahitya Akademi Award in **1983** for his novel **Karmelin**.
 
• He also won the **Vimala V. Pai Vishwa** Konkani Sahitya Puraskar award for his novel **Tsunami Simon in 2011**.
 
• He is the co-founder of the **Goa Arts** and** Literature Festival**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2082e777b092a76afccaa959f514612b681e8f4dae75e6d9de49af01337bac43.png] 

 
• Jnanpith Award

 
 
• Jnanpith Award Instituted in 1961, with no posthumous conferral, the award is bestowed only on Indian writers writing in Indian languages included in the Eighth Schedule to the Constitution of India and English.
 
• It Rewards ₹11 lakh cash prize and a bronze replica of Saraswati, the Hindu goddess of knowledge and wisdom.
 
• It was First awarded in 1965.
 
• The first recipient of the award was the Malayalam writer G. Sankara Kurup who received the award in 1965 for his collection of poems, Odakkuzhal (The Bamboo Flute), published in 1950.
